summary: Project only nine workflow fields from persisted parser summaries before Python decoding, excluding unrelated page, vision, CAD, takeoff and geometry arrays.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving efficiency and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Measured synthetic baseline showing complete-summary transfer and decode overhead
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued product efficiency improvements.
known_limitations: The benchmark is synthetic and local; customer-project latency depends on summary size, document count and local SQLite behavior.
The endpoint still rebuilds the deterministic index per request; persistent caching is intentionally not added because run summaries may change during analysis.
No model, mailbox, connector or external provider request is used.
